home.sub: Choose what you are going through, read real stories from people who understand, and share when you are ready. No real name, no phone number.
home.safe1b: Sakina connects people with shared experiences. Every post passes a safety check, and risky messages go to a therapist first.
home.safe2b: Verified psychologists and psychiatrists guide some rooms and read flagged posts. They listen and guide; they never diagnose or prescribe here.
home.safe3b: If you are in danger, you don't need an account. Help options are on every page.

how.title: How it works
how.s1: Choose what you are going through
how.s1b: Pick one or more communities. Nobody else sees which ones you follow.
how.s2b: Stories are open to read without an account. Take your time, there is no pressure to write.
how.s3b: Join with just a nickname and a password. Post a story, reply, or sit in a live room.

rooms.title: Live rooms right now
rooms.sub: Sit with others in real time. Some rooms are guided by a therapist, others are open peer rooms watched by moderators.

faq.title: Questions people ask
faq.a1: Yes. You choose a nickname, and your avatar is an abstract gradient. We never ask for your real name, phone number or a photo. If you add a recovery email, it is encrypted and nobody on the site sees it.
faq.a2: No. Sakina is peer support: people sharing what helped them. Therapists guide some rooms and read flagged posts, but they never diagnose or prescribe here.
faq.q3: Do I need an account to read?
faq.a3: No. Reading stories and looking around is open to everyone. You only need an anonymous account to post, reply, react or chat.
faq.q4: What if someone posts something worrying?
faq.a4: Every post passes a safety check. Risky messages are held for a therapist before anyone else sees them, and you can report anything that worries you.
faq.a5: Arabic, French and English, in any mix. Write in the language that feels most natural to you.
faq.a6: Yes. Sakina is free to read and free to join.

final.title: You don't have to carry it alone.
final.body: Join with a nickname, read at your own pace, and share when you are ready.

design.sub: Every token and component Sakina is built from, live. Switch language and theme to check each one in Arabic, French and English, light and dark.

design.tokensNote: Theme tokens. These change with light and dark mode; components only use these names.
design.colorRule: Pastels are for surfaces and illustration. Text uses ink, or the deep ink tints on soft fills, at 4.5:1 contrast or better. Crisis and errors use terracotta, never alarm red.
design.sample: Someone else has walked this path before.
design.typeNote: English and French: Bricolage Grotesque for headings, Instrument Sans for text, JetBrains Mono for labels. Arabic: Cairo for headings, IBM Plex Sans Arabic for text, no letter spacing. Wordmark: Reem Kufi.
design.buttonsNote: One primary button per view. Every target is at least 44px. Arrows and send icons mirror in Arabic.

about.title: A calm place to be heard, without giving your name.
about.lead: Sakina (سكينة) means calm, tranquillity. It is an anonymous peer-support community for people living with mental-health struggles, and for those who care about them.
about.why1: Talking about mental health is still hard. Many people stay silent because they are afraid of being recognised by family, colleagues or neighbours.
about.why2: Sakina removes that fear: no real name, no phone number, no photo. Just people who understand, sharing what helped them get through.

anon.title: Anonymous by default
anon.body: You are a nickname and an abstract avatar. What you share is never tied to who you are.

safe.title: Safety comes first
safe.body: Every post passes a safety check, and risky messages go to a therapist before anyone else sees them.

peer.title: Peers, not prescriptions
peer.body: Lived experience helps in a way advice cannot. Here, people share what worked for them, not diagnoses.

lang.title: In your language
lang.body: Arabic, French and English, written the way people really speak, in any mix.

members.title: People who understand
members.body: Adults who live with something similar, or care for someone who does. They read, share, react and sit in rooms together.

therapists.title: Verified professionals
therapists.body: Psychologists and psychiatrists guide some rooms and read flagged posts. They listen and guide; they never diagnose or prescribe here.

moderators.title: Keeping it kind
moderators.body: Moderators read reports, hide what breaks the guidelines and keep rooms safe. Every action they take is logged.

about.privacySub: Anonymity protects you. Here is exactly what we ask for, and what we never do.
about.never4: An ID card or any document
about.private1: Your recovery email is encrypted. Members and therapists never see it; admins only see it masked.
about.private2: Your age range and country are private by default. You decide whether to show them.
about.private3: Which communities you follow is visible only to you.
about.private4: Admins only see what they need for safety, and every admin action is logged.
about.notBody: Sakina is not medical care, therapy, diagnosis or an emergency service. If you are in danger, use Get help now on any page.
about.ctaTitle: Come in, at your own pace
about.ctaBody: Start by reading. When you feel ready, join with just a nickname.

guidelines.title: How we take care of each other
guidelines.lead: Sakina works because people feel safe here. These guidelines apply to stories, replies, rooms and 1:1 chats.

anon.title: Keep everyone anonymous
anon.body: Don't share your real name, phone number, address or social accounts, or anyone else's. Not even in a private chat.

kind.title: Be kind, even when you disagree
kind.body: No insults, mocking, judging or pressure. Everyone here is carrying something.

experience.title: Share experience, not prescriptions
experience.body: Talk about what helped you. Don't tell others which medication to take or stop, and don't diagnose anyone.

veil.title: Warn before heavy topics
veil.body: Use a content warning when you write about self-harm, loss, violence, abuse, food or substances, so others can choose to read.

noContact.title: No selling, no recruiting
noContact.body: No ads, links to sell something, fundraising or moving people to other apps. Sakina is not a marketplace.

report.title: Report, don't argue
report.body: If something feels wrong, report it privately. A moderator will look. You can also block someone at any time.

danger.title: If someone is in danger, act
danger.body: If a member seems at risk, report it: the report goes to a therapist first. If it is you, use Get help now.

guidelines.modsTitle: What happens when something breaks the guidelines
guidelines.modsSub: We prefer guiding to punishing. Moderators and therapists step in like this:
guidelines.step1: A safety check reads every post. Risky ones are held for a therapist before anyone sees them.
guidelines.step2: Reports go to a moderator, or to a therapist first when someone may be in danger.
guidelines.step3: Content that breaks the guidelines is hidden or removed.
guidelines.step4: Repeated or serious harm can pause an account. You can still read and get help while it is paused.
guidelines.dangerTitle: If you are in danger right now
guidelines.dangerBody: You don't need an account to get help. Choose your country to see who you can call, and try a short grounding exercise.
